ns0:g.ns0:text: Capacitor series and parallel equivalents follow charge and voltage constraints
Series floating intermediate node with zero net initial charge gives equal plate-charge magnitude; parallel capacitors share voltage. Equivalent terminal

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: energy for this initially uncharged network is W=½C
²; at 10 V, series stores 60 µJ and parallel 250 µJ.
